findings.summary: Request status uses a bespoke Chip with a local _status() switch instead of the shared MobileStatusPill, so it lacks the color-coded status palette used everywhere else.
findings.fix: Replace `Chip(label: Text(_status(item.status)))` with `MobileStatusPill(item.status)` and remove the local `_status` map, giving consistent color-coded pills.

findings.summary: The top summary uses a bespoke three-column metric Row with a private _metric() helper instead of the shared MetricCard/MetricGrid, breaking the standard metric styling.
findings.fix: Replace the Card+Row+_metric block with MetricGrid(cards: [('الخدمات','${data.catalog.length}',Icons.design_services_outlined),('طلباتي','${data.requests.length}',Icons.list_alt_outlined),('مفتوحة','$openCount',Icons.pending_actions_outlined)]) and delete the private _metric helper.

findings.summary: The requests list has no search or filter affordance despite MobileFilterBar being the standard, so users cannot search/filter requests or see a result count.
findings.fix: Add a MobileFilterBar above the list (search by title/serviceName/number plus status choice chips) wired to local filter state, with resultLabel showing the count and onClear resetting it, matching other list pages.

findings.summary: The error state is a bare centered Text with no icon, brand header, or retry action, inconsistent with the app's richer error presentation.
findings.fix: Wrap the error in a Card/centered column with an error icon (colorScheme.error), the message, and a retry TextButton that calls ref.invalidate(myServicePortalProvider).

findings.summary: The empty-requests state is a plain centered Text with no icon, brand mark, or call-to-action, unlike the design system's fuller empty states.
findings.fix: Give the empty state an illustrative icon (Icons.support_agent_outlined) and a call-to-action button ('طلب خدمة') so it matches other empty headers in the app.

findings.summary: The AppBar shows only a text title with no BrandLogoMark, unlike app bars/headers elsewhere that carry the association brand mark.
findings.fix: Add a leading BrandLogoMark (assets/brand/association-logo-*.png) to the AppBar for brand consistency with other screens.

findings.summary: The request ListTile is non-interactive (no onTap) so tapping a request does nothing, and the leading icon has no semantic label.
findings.fix: If a detail view exists, add an onTap to the ListTile; otherwise wrap the leading Icon in a Semantics label and confirm the tile is intentionally read-only.

findings.summary: The loading state uses a hardcoded SizedBox height of 220 to fake vertical centering, giving inconsistent placement versus other pages.
findings.fix: Use a shared loading placeholder (e.g. Padding(padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 120), child: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()))) instead of a magic 220px SizedBox, matching other pages.
